quests.title: Temaria Game

dialogue.t: Hi, big sis(big bro)! I have some good stuff here...
How pitiful, being forced to do shady business at such a young age.
It's not what you're thinking! I wanted to ask if you wanted to play a game of Temari with me.
Temari?
It's simple, I will hide the Temari somewhere nearby. If big sis(big bro) can find it within the time of a Temari song, you win.

dialogue.sit: Is that how Temari is played?

dialogue.t: Huh? An awesome Big Sister adventurer taught me. And she said...
"Kujirai, remember. You must say, 'If you win, you'll get the good stuff.'"
So, big sis(big bro), if you win, you'll get the good stuff.
Good stuff! {NICKNAME}, Paimon thinks it's only right to play with children!

dialogue.sit: But I still think Temari isn't played like this...

dialogue.t: It may be a gameplay that only local people know, let's not care about such details.
You're Kid Kujirai, right? We'll play with you!
Yay!
Eh, is it too hard for you...
That's because Paimon was just warming up!
Big sis(Big bro), do you want to try again?
Of course! {NICKNAME}, we need to show Kid Kujirai how good we are!
Woohoo! The goal is to find the Temari within the time limit!
Big sis(Big bro) is amazing, you found it right away!
Hoho, {NICKNAME} is a seasoned traveler who has been to many nations.
Wow! Have you also been to Mondstadt?
That's so cool! I heard from that Big Sister that there are many beautiful places in Mondstadt, like Stormterror's Ruins with super-duper tall towers...
Yup! I wonder if that tower is taller, or if the Almighty Shogun's Tenshukaku is taller...
Kid Kujirai, why are you out alone in the wild?
Because when my sister was fishing, she thought I would scare the fish away, so she let me go out to play.
Once, I met that Big Sister who was an adventurer. She saw that I was bored, so she gave me a lot of Temari, and told me to "find greedy travelers to play with."
We're not greedy! We're worried! Paimon's worried that you might be bored playing by yourself!
That's right, I think big sis(big bro) is really nice, I'm so happy.
You're a kid alone in the wild, aren't you afraid of running into danger? And you even have "good stuff" on you.
You're really kind, big sis(big bro). Don't worry, that Big Sister adventurer taught me. As long as I do something to it, the Temari can turn into a bomb.
Eek, that's so dangerous!
It's not! I've blasted away a lot of bad guys, like hilichurls and slimes!
You're the dangerous one!
Oh yes, big sis(big bro), if you want to play a game of Temari with other friends...
I'll leave a Temari here! Here are the rules...
When you hide a Temari, you have to hide it within the time of a Temari song. The person who is looking for it will also find it within a song's time. That will make things fair!
It's so scary to think that we're actually playing with bombs...
Don't be scared, big sis(big bro). Big Sister adventurer told me "Only the bad guys will be bombed. Probably."
"Probably!?"
I'm off to play somewhere else! Bye-bye, big sis(big bro)!

quests.description: Kid Kujirai has something to share…
